actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.dev.DatabaseServices.get#DatabaseJobStatus').parameters({jobId: String(jobId || '')}).call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Object.assign({}, out, {errors, canAdmin: ec.user.hasPermission('DATABASE_ADMIN')}))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.dev.DatabaseServices.cancel#DatabaseJob').parameters({jobId: String(jobId || '')}).call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Object.assign({}, out, {errors}))
